name: Roprachtice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of yellow, red and yellow in the ratio 1:1:1, with a blue lion rampant with red tongue in the hoist yellow.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 July 2019 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
